title: 外澳下雨天
subject: the only surfboard-rental guy open at Wai'ao beach on a rainy weekday teaching an accountant to stand up on a board
caption: Mandarin surf rock in the 1960s instrumental-surf style with a garage edge. Reverb-drenched Fender lead guitar playing twangy low-string melodies; tremolo-picked rhythm guitar; a Farfisa organ holding bright chords; round electric bass walking fast; splashy surf drums with constant snare rolls. Spring reverb on everything, live garage room, amps slightly overdriven. Male voice, deadpan baritone-tenor talking through the verses, shouted gang vocals on the chorus. 168 BPM, E minor. Sunburnt, goofy and stubborn. No trap drums, no autotune, no EDM synths, no ballad slowdown, no modern pop-punk polish.
lyrics:
[Intro - twang guitar and surf drum roll]

[Verse 1]
禮拜三下雨，整條海灘只剩我開店
你穿著襯衫走過來，問板子一小時多少錢
你說你是會計，今天請了特休假
算了三年別人的帳，想算一下自己的浪

[Pre-Chorus]
趴下去，划三下，聽我喊

[Chorus]
站起來，站起來，外澳下雨天
雨打在臉上，跟海水一樣鹹
跌倒了也沒差，反正都已經濕
站起來，再一次，第十七次

[Verse 2]
你喝了半個太平洋，眼鏡沉在海底
我說沒關係，龜山島也看不清
到了第四十分鐘，你站了兩秒鐘
叫得比颱風還大聲，嚇跑一整排海鷗

[Pre-Chorus]
趴下去，划三下，看前面

[Chorus]
站起來，站起來，外澳下雨天
雨打在臉上，跟海水一樣鹹
兩秒鐘也算數，記在你帳本上
站起來，下禮拜三，我還在這邊

[Outro - organ and twang fade]
板子算你便宜，雨天打八折
會計先生，記得幫我報稅
